PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?z ?tn ?tp WHERE {
  ?ahu a brick:AirHandlingUnit ; rdfs:label "AHU02" .
  ?z brick:isLocatedIn ?ahu .
  ?tp brick:hasProperty ?z2 ; a brick:AirTemperatureSensor .
  ?tp ref:hasExternalReference ?t .
}
